subtitle: A count big enough to need the bar
description: Five hundred and twelve cobblestone. The bar fills in over
several screens of mining, which is the point: a count is drawn as
a bar, and this is the count that makes the bar worth looking at.
The title above is written as a translation key with an English
fallback -- the other spelling a text field accepts, for a pack or
a mod shipping a questline it wants translated. Nothing else in
this title differs; the key resolves, and the fallback is what
stops a missing translation from drawing a raw key.
